method: Deterministic priority queues generated from current local event/source metadata. Queue membership is a review-priority signal, not a claim about severity or prevalence.

queues.label: Single-source government dataset records
queues.description: Records that should receive source-text follow-up before being used as examples.

queues.label: Year-precision date follow-up
queues.description: Records where the date is currently represented at year precision.

queues.label: Response-depth follow-up
queues.description: Records with limited response notes or no stored public response text.

queues.label: Broad community-label follow-up
queues.description: Records using broad community labels that may deserve narrower source-text review.

queues.label: High-stakes rationale follow-up
queues.description: Records in legal, OCR, Title IX, disability, pregnancy, or athletic-equity categories.

queues.label: Medium/low confidence priority
queues.description: Records that should not be used as examples without checking the underlying source trail.
